title: Ecology - Food Web and Energy Flow
body:
Study the food web diagram of a grassland ecosystem:

```
[GRASSLAND FOOD WEB]

                    HAWK
                   /    \
                  v      v
              SNAKE     OWL
                |      /   \
                v     v     v
              FROG  MOUSE  RABBIT
                \     |     /
                 \    |    /
                  v   v   v
              GRASSHOPPER
                    |
                    v
                  GRASS
                    ^
                    |
                  [SUN]
```

Using the food web above, identify the trophic levels and explain what would happen to the mouse population if all the snakes were removed.
